constraints: This capsule is grounded only in the provided snapshots for `QUICKSTART.md`, `MIGRATION_GUIDE.md`, and `.outcomegraph/materials.lock`; the event files named in `QUICKSTART.md` were not provided as direct snapshots.
The primary operator path remains manual-first after meaningful code changes; autonomous behavior applies only after `og autopilot init` enables Steward.
Prompt optimization is scoped to `.outcomegraph/datasets/`, and activation of the resulting prompt pack requires an explicit `--approve` step.
Safe-by-default `observe` mode limits writes to `.outcomegraph/**` and generated agent-facing exports unless a broader mode is explicitly selected.

The concrete repository-backed verification contract in the provided evidence is the full-spec rollout gate using `uv run og status --json`, `uv run og sync --json`, `uv run og verify --changed --json`, and `uv run og drift`.
Rollout validation still depends on v2-canonical artifact shape for `.outcomegraph/materials.lock`, as documented by the migration guide's dogfood blocker section.
goal: Capture the OutcomeGraph quickstart operator contract for bootstrap, manual-first and autopilot flows, experimental prompt optimization, observe-mode safety boundaries, and release-readiness rollout validation.

oracles.name: full-spec rollout status gate (advisory only in observe mode)
full-spec rollout sync gate (advisory only in observe mode)
full-spec rollout verify gate (advisory only in observe mode)
full-spec rollout drift gate (advisory only in observe mode)
discoverability commands in the quickstart are usage examples, not the capsule's live verification contract
the `og optimize prompts` example is documented capability guidance, not a repository-backed validation oracle
